title.en: Do Majime Jijo no Kon'yaku Soudou! ~Mukuchina Kishi-dan fuku Danchou ni Jitsuwa Betabore Saretemashita~

altTitles.ja: ド真面目侍女の婚約騒動！～無口な騎士団副団長に実はベタ惚れされてました～

altTitles.en: The Engagement Controversy of a Serious Maid!: The Silent Vice-Commander of the Knights is Head Over Heels in Love with Me

description.en:
A devoted and hardworking maid had dedicated her life to her job, reaching an age where she was considered a “spinster.” She had long accepted the idea that she would never marry.But one day, her younger brother asks her to pretend to be his fake lover in front of someone, and she couldn’t bring herself to refuse his request.However, the real shock came when she saw who was present—the Vice Captain of the Knights, the man she had secretly loved for ten years! 

He was never popular among women due to his unkempt appearance, messy hair, and thick beard. But to her, he was a personal hero, having saved her once when she was in trouble. Ever since that moment, she had never been able to forget him. And then, something completely unexpected happens—the Vice Captain suddenly shaves his beard and tidies up his wild hair, revealing his true, strikingly handsome features! The women around him can’t stop staring, but for some reason, his attention remains solely on the serious maid who never once confessed her feelings to him. As if things weren’t complicated enough, she suddenly receives a marriage proposal from one of the kingdom’s most talented young knights!

How will she navigate this emotional chaos? And will she realize that her long-held love was never one-sided?
description.ja: 堅物侍女のサンドラは、仕事ひと筋で嫁き遅れと言われる年齢になり、恋も結婚も諦めていた。周囲からも結婚には程遠いと思われているけれど、本当は騎士団の副団長・イアンに想いを寄せている。そんなある日、最年少で騎士団の精鋭部隊に入った弟・ユリウスから、女避けのため恋人のふりをするように頼まれる。サンドラが渋々引き受け、ユリウスの恋人のふりをしているところをイアンに見られてしまう…！イアンはその後、なぜか長い前髪を切り髭を剃って身なりを整え大変身…!? しかもサンドラに、新たな男性から縁談が舞い込んできて…!?
